description: A project's sources — the papers, books and preprints its pages cite — each with its key (what a page cites it by, e.g. 'IMP26', a BibTeX key), its authors (the name as the work prints it, and 'personId'/'person' where it is a person of the project's register — 'hidden' where you may not see that person), title, year, venue (journal or publisher), identifiers ('arxiv' with its version, 'doi', 'mr', 'zbmath', 'isbn'), its PDF ('pdf': an attachment of an issue or a page, with its address — or 'hidden') and how far it is checked. 'check' is 'unchecked' (nobody checked it), 'api' (a service — arXiv, Crossref, zbMATH Open — agreed with it), 'mismatch' (it disagrees with what it names; 'checkNote' says how) or 'manual' (a person checked it against the original; 'checkedBy'). 'dagger' is true for unchecked and mismatch: the † a bibliography marks such a reference with. Read a work's description here rather than from a page's own list. Ordered by key. Anybody who sees the project.

check.description: Only sources so checked: unchecked, api, mismatch, manual — or 'dagger' for unchecked and mismatch together.

q.description: Words its key, title, venue, an author's name or an identifier holds, case aside.
